text: An explicit expected-unmatched selector validates a nonblank declaration for every focal trial. A nonselected trial lacking any reference in an observed inventory must therefore remain ReferenceNotDeclared/NoMatch; absence of an exported reference is insufficient evidence of an intentionally unmatched design. The no-selector inventory-only convention is retained for existing plans. This changes only classification and diagnostic wording; the complete private API scientific result digest is unchanged before/after. Synthetic old-probe/lure tests establish the distinction.
